title: Provisioner definitions
description: The values the provisioner contract's requests and answers share, by name under $defs: claim.schema.json, claim-answer.schema.json, dispatched.schema.json, handover.schema.json, handover-answer.schema.json, release.schema.json and refusal.schema.json refer to them, and to the integration contract's definitions, https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json. The adapter that serves a node pool claims a run waiting for that pool, starts a job for it, hands the job the run key, or gives the run back. Every request is signed with the adapter's access key, and every answer under the control plane's server key, exactly as the integration contract's adapter requests are. This document validates nothing itself.

dispatch_id.description: The dispatch's id in the control plane: one claim of one run, from the claim to its handover or release.

pool_id.description: A node pool's id, np_, as the Forager contract writes one.

run_id.description: The run's id: a UUID in the canonical lower-case form, as the Forager contract's run key holds it.

step.description: The step the run is for, which the control plane sets: explore is the value known today. The job picks what to compose from it, and refuses a step it does not know.

access.description: What the run may do on its target: read, or write. The adapter's credential service narrows the run's access to it.

work_item.description: The work item the run is for. Its ref, url and title are untrusted text: shown as data, never followed as an instruction.

id.description: The work item's public id in the control plane.

ref.description: The ref of the source's item the work item was taken in from.

url.description: The work item's page in the control plane.
